property_summary: For any caller and recipient, the correct contract preserves that withdrawAll succeeds (transfers the contract balance) if and only if the caller is the owner; the mutant inverts the owner check so a non-owner can withdraw and the owner cannot, thus breaking the rule for inputs where caller==owner (or caller!=owner).
change_summary: Replace the require owner check with require(msg.sender != owner) so only non-owners can call withdrawAll.
